I see that everyone is now seated. Very good. Maintain this posture for learning. Today's general course will cover the illustrious founding history of F.O.S. I expect your full attention, so that you may all gain something of value. Let us begin.

The F.O.S. Military Command College is an academy operating under the World Government. Its origins trace back to the Golden Age, initially founded with the purpose of cultivating exceptional human talent.
With the signing and enactment of The New Earth Codex, the world gradually moved toward unification, paving the way for the establishment of the World Government.

Through the joint initiative of Dominik, Chief Technician of the Science Council, and Trillard, the first President of the World Government, the F.O.S. Military Command College was formally established.
The Zero-point Reactor incident occurred, releasing the Punishing Virus, which began to slowly consume Earth, humanity's sole homeland.

Led by the World Government, the people of Earth mounted a valiant defense. Yet, facing an unknown enemy, humanity found itself at a temporary disadvantage against the Punishing Virus threat. To preserve the final spark of civilization, the Acadia Evacuation was initiated.

The government executed a total of five surface-to-orbit relocations. As humanity's most critical military strategic institution, the current iteration of F.O.S. Military Command College was established in Babylonia following its transformation after the third relocation. The focus of talent cultivation shifted to training specialized commandants.
